title: Trajectory-Aware Benchmark Subset Selection for Cost-Efficient Software Engineering Agent Regression Testing
abstract: arXiv:2609.24928v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous software engineering agents (SWE-agents) automate coding tasks. Each agent update may require re-running the full benchmark to detect regressions and improvements, at a cost of hundreds of millions of LLM tokens per run, which makes evaluation a bottleneck. One solution is to evaluate only a subset of benchmark instances. Yet, simple approaches, such as random sampling or stratified random sampling based on past pass/fail outcomes, risk producing high variance and unrepresentative subsets. We turn to agent trajectories, the step-by-step record of the actions an agent took. We propose a trajectory-aware subset selection approach that replaces random sampling with deterministic selection based on trajectory embeddings. We first group test set instances by their test outcome in a recent full test run to preserve the historical pass/fail rate, then select the subset using the trajectory's embedding space. translated_title: 面向成本高效的软件工程智能体回归测试的轨迹感知基准子集选择
translated_abstract: 自主软件工程智能体（SWE-agents）能够自动化完成编码任务。每次智能体更新都可能需要重新运行完整基准测试，以检测回归和改进，而每次运行的成本高达数亿个LLM token，这使得评估成为瓶颈。一种解决方案是仅评估基准实例的一个子集。然而，简单的方法，如随机抽样或基于过去通过/失败结果的分层随机抽样，可能产生高方差且不具代表性的子集。我们转向智能体轨迹，即智能体所采取行动的逐步记录。我们提出了一种轨迹感知的子集选择方法，用基于轨迹嵌入的确定性选择取代随机抽样。我们首先根据最近一次完整测试运行中的测试结果对测试集实例进行分组，以保留历史通过/失败率，然后在轨迹的嵌入空间中选择子集。我们评估了76个子集……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出一种基于智能体轨迹嵌入的确定性基准子集选择方法，在保留历史通过/失败率的同时，大幅降低软件工程智能体回归测试的评估成本。
en_tdlr: Proposes a trajectory-aware deterministic benchmark subset selection method based on agent trajectory embeddings, which preserves historical pass/fail rates while significantly reducing the evaluation cost of software engineering agent regression testing.
